summary: Silk Muay Thai is a Pattaya Muay Thai gym offering training packages with private on-site rooms, meals, pool and sauna access, and airport transfers.

facts.label: Sessions
facts.value: 1 or 2 Muay Thai sessions plus 1 Fundamentals class, depending on package

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Private rooms with bathroom, air conditioning, mini fridge, Wi-Fi and outdoor space
facts.quote: All our rooms are private, with their own bathroom, air conditioning, mini fridge, Wi-Fi and a private outdoor space.

facts.label: Facilities
facts.value: Pool, sauna and shared laundry included with every stay
facts.quote: Every stay includes access to the swimming pool, sauna and shared laundry area.

facts.label: Hours
facts.value: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM
